columns.name: rule_id
columns.defaultConstraints: REFERENCES recurring_rules (id) ON DELETE SET NULL

dialectAwareDefaultConstraints.sqlite: REFERENCES recurring_rules (id) ON DELETE SET NULL

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurring_rules" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH(TRIM("name")) BETWEEN 1 AND 80), "cadence" TEXT NOT NULL, "anchor_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "next_index" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "bonus" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_posted_on" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "missions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH(TRIM("name")) BETWEEN 1 AND 80), "bonus" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "awarded_bonus" INTEGER NULL, "rule_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES recurring_rules (id) ON DELETE SET NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "quests" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH(TRIM("name")) BETWEEN 1 AND 80), "note" TEXT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("note") <= 500), "difficulty" TEXT NOT NULL, "mission_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES missions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "board" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, "awarded_xp" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rule_quests" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "rule_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES recurring_rules (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "difficulty" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_state" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("id" = 1), "total_xp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK("total_xp" >= 0), "hero_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "language" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system', "theme" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system', "display_font" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'figtree', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "calendar_events" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH(TRIM("name")) BETWEEN 1 AND 80), "note" TEXT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("note") <= 500), "location" TEXT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("location") <= 120), "event_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_minute" INTEGER NULL CHECK("start_minute" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), "end_minute" INTEGER NULL CHECK("end_minute" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), "repeat_kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "easter_offset" INTEGER NULL, "nth_month" INTEGER NULL, "nth_weekday" INTEGER NULL, "nth_ordinal" INTEGER NULL, "repeat_end" TEXT NULL, "on_board" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("on_board" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "calendar_skipped_dates" ("event_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES calendar_events (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "skipped_on" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("event_id", "skipped_on"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "calendar_completions" ("event_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES calendar_events (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "occurrence_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "awarded_xp" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("event_id", "occurrence_date"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "note_nodes" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "parent_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES note_nodes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "is_folder" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_folder" IN (0, 1)), "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH(TRIM("name")) BETWEEN 1 AND 80), "body" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK(LENGTH("body") <= 100000), "auto_name" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("auto_name" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL);
